Case studies, maps, reports, dashboards and code. Most items were published by IMPACT Initiatives (REACH) and FAO as team work; I produced or contributed to each.

```{=html}
<div class="type-filter" role="group" aria-label="Filter work by type">
  <button type="button" data-cat="" aria-pressed="true">All</button>
  <button type="button" data-cat="Case study" aria-pressed="false">Case studies</button>
  <button type="button" data-cat="Map" aria-pressed="false">Maps</button>
  <button type="button" data-cat="Report" aria-pressed="false">Reports</button>
  <button type="button" data-cat="Dashboard" aria-pressed="false">Dashboards</button>
  <button type="button" data-cat="Code" aria-pressed="false">Code</button>
</div>
<script>
(function () {
  const buttons = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.type-filter button'));
  const mark = (cat) => buttons.forEach(b => b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(b.dataset.cat === cat)));
  buttons.forEach(b => b.addEventListener('click', () => {
    const cat = b.dataset.cat;
    if (window.quartoListingCategory) window.quartoListingCategory(btoa(encodeURIComponent(cat)));
    mark(cat);
  }));
  // Reflect a category already in the address (e.g. work/#category=Map)
  const m = decodeURIComponent(location.hash).match(/category=([^&]*)/);
  if (m) mark(decodeURIComponent(m[1]));
})();
</script>
```

::: {#work}
:::

<p class="small-note">Work for ICRC and for the current Nigeria assessment is internal or not yet published; the Nigeria case study and the public code show how it was done. Code is built with AI-assisted development, reviewed and tested by me.</p>
